scope: First typed LLM-authored REST mechanical execution through actual host; offline TDD, CLEF decision worker follows separately
mechanics: Positive fresh Basic Skill 1 effective level >=3 or Summoner Basic 5018 >=1 is a narrow conservative sit gate, not ownership/casting/spending authority
Fresh received transport/life/vitals/skill provenance required before new sit; unknown hidden statuses remain UNKNOWN and server acceptance requires later pose receipt
REST hold persists across ticks and suppresses attack/loot/move/NPC fallback
Fresh HP/SP changes only count as progress; sends or duplicate pose receipts do not
Exit requires a later matching own current-epoch stand receipt before release
acceptance_cases: REST1 actual host typed REST admission and persistent sit hold with continued keepalive and no per-tick cognition
REST2 fresh health/SP progress and paced stand barrier
REST3 invalid/unknown telemetry or missing qualifying skill fails closed
REST4 finite failed pose/no-progress requests one bounded version-bound replan
legacy_preservation: Existing legacy rest behavior unchanged; add opt-in eligibility/pose-observation seams rather than globally tightening old clients
model_contract: Only IDLE/REST after eligibility; existing decoder/core/reader/capture unchanged. Passive IDLE denied-REST regression remains meaningful with unqualified skill context.
exclusions: CLEF decision worker or freeform chat implementation
completion: Four finite actual-host cases under vertical TDD, frozen independent review and unchanged full-root gates; no full milestone closure
